sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: We talked to eight beta testers about shelf scan v1. Three of them (P3, P6, P8) stopped scanning after a wrong book was added to the catalog for them. Everyone liked the speed; nobody liked finding out later that a book on the shelf was not on the shelf.

sections.heading: What we heard
quotes: “I scanned the Linden Street box and it put in Pervasive Games. We have never had that book.” (P3, Denise)
“Two wrong books and I stopped. I don’t have time to audit it.” (P8, Owen)
“If it showed me the list first I’d tap through it on the train.” (P1, Aisha)
“The skinny paperbacks are always the ones it gets wrong.” (P6, Hal)

sections.heading: Themes
bullets: A wrong book costs trust fast (P3, P6, P8)
Glare from glass doors makes scanning unreliable (P3, P2)
Testers want to check the list before it is saved (P1, P4, P7)
Fixing a miss must take one tap (P4, P5, P7)

sections.heading: Recommendations
sections.body: Add a review step: show every spine found, flag the unsure ones, fix a miss in one tap, and add nothing until the steward taps Add. Warn about glare before the photo. Keep auto-add off until accuracy reaches 95%.
